description.value: A sunny Kootenay park set in ponderosa pine and Douglas fir forest, built around Surveyors Lake's warm, sandy swimming beach with on-site kayak and paddleboard rentals; paved internal park roads make it an easy roll for loaded touring bikes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Kalispell Trail Campground as one campground within Kikomun Creek Park, a BC provincial park in the Kootenays. The website (bcparks.ca/kikomun-creek-park/) confirms the park exists, mentions cycling-friendly paved roads, and confirms reservations are available via camping.bcparks.ca. OSM tags indicate capacity of 30, no internet access, no power supply, and a sanitary dump station. The phone number in OSM (+1-250-422-3003) appears to be the park operator (EK Parks Ltd.) and could not be confirmed from the website content, which only lists BC Parks general contact numbers.
concerns: OSM record is for Kalispell Trail Campground specifically, but the website URL covers all of Kikomun Creek Park — amenity details may vary between campgrounds within the park
OSM phone (+1-250-422-3003) and email (info@ekparks.com) are for the park operator EK Parks Ltd. and could not be confirmed from the BC Parks website content
No address available in OSM or on the website for this specific campground
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Provincial park campground in the Kootenays with cycling-friendly infrastructure; a clear fit for touring cyclists on the Highway 3 corridor.

wow_evidence: warm, sandy swimming beach ... paved internal park roads make it an easy roll for loaded touring bikes
